sentences.en: Please make sure that your seat belt is securely fastened.
sentences.zh: 请确保你的安全带系紧。

sentences.en: Please fasten your seat belts, and kindly refrain from smoking.
sentences.zh: 请系好安全带，并且不要吸烟。

sentences.en: If you turn around, I'll fasten your dress for you.
sentences.zh: 你转过身去，我帮你把衣服扣好。
